description: This Java source file defines a class extending JpsModelSerializerExtension for handling Android Gradle module serialization in IntelliJ IDEA's build system. It includes serializers for module options, SDK properties, and facet configurations specific to Android Gradle projects.

classes.name: JpsAndroidGradleModelSerializerExtension
classes.description: Extends JpsModelSerializerExtension to handle Android Gradle module serialization, including facet and SDK properties.

classes.name: JpsAndroidGradleFacetConfigurationSerializer
classes.description: Serializes and deserializes JpsAndroidGradleModuleExtension configurations for modules.

classes.name: JpsAndroidSdkPropertiesSerializer
classes.description: Serializes and deserializes Android SDK properties for modules.

methods.name: getFacetConfigurationSerializers
methods.description: Returns list of facet configuration serializers, specifically for Android Gradle modules.

methods.name: loadModuleOptions
methods.description: Loads module options; if external system ID is 'GRADLE', attaches Gradle system extension.

methods.name: saveModuleOptions
methods.description: Saves module options; sets external system ID attribute if Gradle extension exists.

methods.name: getSdkPropertiesSerializers
methods.description: Returns list of SDK property serializers, specifically for Android SDK.

methods.name: loadExtension
methods.description: Deserializes Android Gradle module extension from XML element.

methods.name: saveExtension
methods.description: Serializes Android Gradle module extension into XML element.

methods.name: loadProperties
methods.description: Loads Android SDK properties from XML element.

methods.name: saveProperties
methods.description: Saves Android SDK properties into XML element.
